requirement_vague: Verify article tagList is correctly stored and persisted as a simple-array
requirement_precise: Create a user (username: 'taglistuser1', email: 'taglistuser1@test.com', password: 'pass123'). Create an article with title 'Multi Tag Article' and tagList ['tag1', 'tag2', 'tag3']. Extract the slug from response. GET /api/articles/{slug}. Verify the article's tagList contains exactly ['tag1', 'tag2', 'tag3'] in array format. Create another article with empty tagList []. GET that article. Verify tagList is an empty array []. This tests the simple-array column handling for tagList.

omissions.description: Article tagList is not stored and persisted as a simple-array column; it is implemented via a many-to-many Tag/ArticleTagLink relationship instead.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement explicitly tests simple-array column handling for tagList persistence. In the code, Article has no tagList/simple-array field; tags are persisted through the Tag model and ArticleTagLink join table, so the specified storage mechanism is absent.
